verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success, professional skill, or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

operational-specificity-faster-general.title: Providing specific operational or inventory details predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
operational-specificity-faster-general.body: Pitches that include precise details about inventory items or operational data, rather than general categories, fund faster for both men and women.

female-business-longevity-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the number of years their business has been running fund faster.
female-business-longevity-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the number of years the business has been operating are associated with increased funding speed.

family-support-needs-faster.title: Mentioning specific family support needs, such as children's education, predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
family-support-needs-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference providing for children's education or specific family support needs are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-marital-status-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention their marital status may fund more slowly.

female-nwtf-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention previous loans from NWTF may fund more slowly.

male-children-ages-slower-puzzle.body: Male borrowers who list the specific ages of their children may fund more slowly.

female-infrastructure-scale-slower.body: Female borrowers who describe business growth in terms of infrastructure or large-scale expansion may fund more slowly.

female-hand-in-hand-slower.body: Mentioning training with Hand in Hand Eastern Africa may predict slower funding for women.

male-aspirational-goals-slower.body: Broader aspirational goals, such as inspiring others, may predict slower funding for men.

female-location-specificity-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific towns or provinces in their pitch may fund faster.

female-husband-support-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention a supportive husband helping with repayment may fund more slowly.

female-greeting-gratitude-faster.body: Female borrowers who combine a geographical greeting with gratitude may fund faster.

female-institutional-partner-faster.body: Female borrowers who name their specific institutional partner (e.g., BRAC, VisionFund) may fund faster.

female-family-future-faster.title: Pitches from women that explicitly mention securing the future of their family are associated with increased funding speed.
female-family-future-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that focusing on the role of a parent predicts slower funding.

female-children-details-faster.title: Pitches from women that specify the number, age, or schooling status of their children are associated with increased funding speed.
female-children-details-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that focusing on the role of a parent predicts slower funding.

female-age-faster.title: Female borrowers who include their age in the pitch may fund faster.
female-age-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning specific age predicts slower funding for women.

male-geography-slower.title: Detailed descriptions of local geography may slow funding for male borrowers.

family-focus-slower-general.title: Pitches that focus on the borrower's role as a parent or mention family-related financial hardships tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

business-goals-faster-general.title: Pitches that focus on the borrower's professional ambitions or the quality and reputation of their business tend to fund faster for both men and women.
business-goals-faster-general.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for more specific gendered findings.

female-children-aspirational-faster.title: Pitches from women that mention the educational needs of their children or a brighter future for them accelerate funding.
female-children-aspirational-faster.retrospective: Generalized to gender-neutral claim after evidence from male pairs.

female-gratitude-faster.title: Direct thank you to lenders may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-gratitude-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that gratitude appears in slower pitches.

female-husband-occupation-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the occupation of their husband may fund faster.
female-husband-occupation-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning a supportive husband predicts slower funding.

male-asset-goals-faster.title: Male borrowers who mention long-term goals of asset acquisition, such as land, may fund faster.
male-asset-goals-faster.retrospective: Retired as stale to maintain puzzle cap.
